title: from_content/merge_from_content accept plaintext passwords silently
description: CredentialStore::from_content() and merge_from_content() in crates/auth/src/store.rs parse user:hash lines but never call parse_bcrypt_cost. A credential file containing plaintext passwords (e.g. 'alice:mypassword') is accepted with no error. bcrypt::verify then always returns false so that user can never authenticate. The startup panic guard only covers from_credentials(); the file-load paths have no equivalent check.
